name: Isomorphic Domain Mapping (Equivalence Classes)
description: I mapped the graph connectivity problem to a system of variables and equality constraints. Finding a minimal connected component translates to finding a minimal subset of equality constraints that forces a target subset of variables to be equal. By removing all spatial and graph-theoretic terminology ("components", "merged", "parts"), models relying on keyword association are less likely to recognize the underlying tree structure and apply the optimal DFS/subtree algorithm, instead getting confused by equivalence relations or attempting generic optimization.
